propositions: Passing a search frontier exclusion list to resumptions via data-shaped evidence block inside untrusted_ticket_context fence does not reduce re-search overlap rate relative to control cache-seeding resumption.
Treatment arm exhibited equal or higher re-search overlap rates on both test tickets (45c1: +78% relative increase, 8d74: +60% relative increase), failing the predeclared >=30% reduction threshold.
Frontier block rendered inert by fence design; model repeatedly re-grounded files and re-executed searches already listed as searched-and-empty in the evidence.
Overlap metric denominator effect: efficient runs with fewer total tool calls but repeated arguments scored worse on overlap rate than higher-volume runs, masking absolute efficiency gains.

Cache-seeded resumption via verdict cache already removes dominant redundancy (re-proving credited criteria); remaining re-grounding of unproven criteria cannot be suppressed by untrusted data-shaped exclusion list.
